name: aPDF
description: aPDF is a versatile platform for managing and editing PDF documents, offering tools for conversion, annotation, and secure sharing.

events.d: Create a PDF from HTML with options for page size, orientation, margins, scale, header/footer, or webhook.
Extract readable text from a PDF file. Supports sync or async processing with optional webhook.
Create a new PDF containing only the pages you select.
Combine selected pages from multiple PDFs into a single new PDF; choose page ranges, async processing, and webhook.
Search for text in a PDF; choose case sensitivity, use regex, or run async with webhook.
Extract text and structured data from a PDF file; supports async processing with optional webhook.
Split a PDF into separate files or extract selected pages; choose pages and optionally enable async webhook.
Convert a PDF to PNG or JPEG images. Choose pages, color mode, DPI, and optionally run async with a webhook.
Add an owner password and optional user password to a PDF. Supports async processing and webhook notifications.
Retrieve PDF documents, filter by status, name or ID, and set results per page.
Reduce a PDF file's size by compressing it; optionally send a webhook notification when the compression is complete.
Get the current status of a PDF processing job using its Job ID.
Create a PDF document from a template or provided data.

events.n: Convert Scanned PDFs to Searchable PDFs
events.d: Convert scanned PDFs into searchable, selectable-text PDFs using OCR; specify the file URL and optional webhook.
Extracts text from a PDF file URL; optionally sends results to a webhook URL.
Runs when new document is created in aPDF. Polls for documents created since last check.
Runs when a new recipient link is created for the selected APDF document.
